findings.evidence: Lines 203–218 define the structure with only `reflect_isPairStabilizer` as an introduction rule; lines 1103–1106 and 1335 reconstruct the composite and identity stabilizers inline.
findings.fix: Add `Bilin.isPairStabilizer_id (g a b)` and `Bilin.IsPairStabilizer.comp` next to `reflect_isPairStabilizer`, and use them at lines 1103–1106 and 1335.
findings.issue: `Bilin.IsPairStabilizer` is introduced as "an element of the stabilizer ... inside the isometry group" but gets no closure API: the identity element is built by hand at line 1335 (`⟨Bilin.isIsometry_id gWit, rfl, rfl⟩`) and the composite of two stabilizers by hand at lines 1103–1106 (`fun v w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, h₁.isometry _ _, h₂.isometry _ _]`, plus two `fixes_left`/`fixes_right` rewrites). Consumers of the new general notion must re-derive the group operations.

findings.evidence: Lines 366–372: the stated lemma concludes only `F t = A` from a supplied `J p p' = A • (p + p')`; grep for a second `HasFormFactor` hypothesis in the `HasFormFactor` namespace (lines 350–391) returns nothing.
findings.fix: Add `HasFormFactor.formFactor_eq (hF : HasFormFactor g m2 J F) (hF' : HasFormFactor g m2 J F') (hp hp' hP) : F (g (p'-p) (p'-p)) = F' (g (p'-p) (p'-p))`, proved by `hF.formFactor_eq_of_apply_eq_smul hp hp' hP (hF' p p' hp hp')`.
findings.issue: `HasFormFactor.formFactor_eq_of_apply_eq_smul`'s docstring claims "In particular two form factors of one family agree at every such `t`", but no such lemma exists — the uniqueness of `F` on realised momentum transfers, the only extensionality `HasFormFactor` admits, is left for every consumer to assemble.

summary: No compatibility residue and no hidden infrastructure; bodies stay unexposed with `(rfl)` restatements. Two characteristic lemmas are missing: the new `Bilin.IsPairStabilizer` has no identity/composition closure (both open-coded in-file), and the determination of `F` that `formFactor_eq_of_apply_eq_smul`'s docstring advertises is not stated.
